name: chaos-monkey-ux-sandbox
title_zh: 专挑刚做完的前端下手，把缺的兜底全补齐
tagline_zh: 刚写完界面就让它去撞坏数据、断网、慢响应——撞完自动生成错误边界和加载态，不用你手写一个 try-catch。
tagline_en: Right after you build UI, it crashes it with bad data, offline, slow nets—then auto-writes the error boundaries.
desc_en: Adversarially break a freshly built frontend in a headless browser, then generate the error boundaries, fallbacks, and guards it lacked. Use after building or changing UI, or when asked to test error states, harden a component, check loading/empty/error handling, find race conditions, test offline or slow network behavior, or stress a page with bad API data.
why_zh: 不是报错就停，而是把崩溃当需求：每个炸点都变成一段可落地的守卫代码，等于雇了个专砸场子的测试兼补锅匠。
why_en: It doesn't stop at finding crashes—it treats each break as a spec, generating guard code on the spot. A dedicated.
limit_zh: 只认无头浏览器里能跑的现代前端；产物是边界/兜底代码片段，不负责改你的业务逻辑。对纯后端或非浏览器场景无效。
limit_en: Only for modern frontends runnable in a headless browser; outputs boundary/fallback snippets, not business-logic fixes. Useless for pure backend or.
title_en: Break your fresh frontend, then add the fallbacks it lacked
